mechanism.claim: A volatile BTC path whose nonadjacent horizontal-visibility edges overwhelmingly rise or fall has multiscale directional ordering that is not captured by endpoint return alone. At a fresh upper-tail visibility-direction onset confirmed by completed displacement, follow that graph-implied direction for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of lag-weighted nonadjacent visibility-edge displacement and completed block return
mechanism.why_distinct: Path efficiency, endpoint-chord bow, excursion ordering, recurrence, persistent topology and ordinal patterns do not construct a horizontal visibility graph. HVHVD uses only the strict pairwise visibility relation and lag-weighted signs of nonadjacent graph edges; it reuses no event set or control and uses no volume, flow, count, funding, OI, premium, fitted outcome, or post-entry data.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed variation must occupy its causal upper 35 percent and absolute graph direction its causal upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: 06:05/14:05/22:05 UTC visibility-graph onsets are absent from Gross9 structural clocks

features.block: 96 exact epoch-aligned five-minute closes formed from 480 unique coherent BTCUSDT perpetual one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.log_price_nodes: natural logarithm of the 96 five-minute closes in chronological order
features.horizontal_visibility_edge: for i<j, edge exists iff every intermediate node k satisfies x_k<min(x_i,x_j); only nonadjacent edges j-i>=2 enter the statistic
features.edge_direction: strict sign of x_j-x_i; equal endpoint edge invalidates the block
features.visibility_direction: sum over nonadjacent edges of (j-i)*sign(x_j-x_i) divided by sum(j-i); at least 24 nonadjacent edges; finite strict nonzero
features.direction_strength_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(visibility_direction) over at most 270 source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared five-minute log(close/open) returns), finite strict positive
features.block_return: log(last five-minute close/first five-minute open), finite strict nonzero and same sign as visibility_direction
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding scheduled source-valid decision ineligible; missing or invalid prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval and final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent graph-theoretic multiscale path-ordering mechanism selected from formula-absence and complete-source audit only

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no graph relation, edge subset, weighting, minimum edge count, history, rank, threshold, variation, confirmation, onset, clock, hold, side, subset, source, or control repair
